NewsArticle.Title: Circle 4 Armor Quests
NewsArticle.Content: Mundanes report of a Sylvan deep within the woods who remembers the legendary garments whose secret weaving and construction has been keep alive over the millenia by the fae. Likewise mundanes report of a Dwarf deep in the caves under Abel's Isle who keeps alive the secrets of smith the legendary armors, including Emerald Platemail. These armor quests can only be attempted at level 71 (and level 56 for Warriors who have additional sets of armor), because the armor can only be worn at level 71 or greater. Noble versions of these garments can also be gained by recognition for outstanding creativity. [Click here](http://www.darkages.com/2000/atavism/contest.html) to learn about gaining noble garments by your creativity. Noble versions can be worn as low as level 11-31 and do not offer the combat protection.
